verdict.rationale: The 01 documents that the language model can be customized by editing server profiles, so model selection is a first-party documented configuration. However, the evidence never shows pointing it at a custom or self-hosted endpoint, such as a base URL, API key setting, or OpenAI-compatible server. The Realtime API flag only selects OpenAI's own service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom/OpenAI-compatible endpoint configuration (base URL, auth), examples of non-default providers or local models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point the agent at my own model endpoint (OpenAI-compatible or otherwise) through documented configuration

citations.quote: Customize behavior, language model, system message, and more by editing profiles in the `software/source/server/profiles` directory.
It processes input, executes commands, generates responses, and manages core logic using Open Interpreter.
